description: Zi Wei Dou Shu limits for a year, month or day: decade, annual, monthly and daily palaces with flying four transformations and notes. Price: $0.10 per period.

birth.description: Birth data in local clock time (year, month, day, hour, minute; longitude + tz for true solar time). Build it with birth_form.

dstOff.description: True if the record ignores DST

chart_id.description: Saved chart id from my_charts, instead of birth (needs a MingGe account)

gender.description: Required with `birth` (taken from the saved chart with chart_id)

month.description: Gregorian month; read as the solar-term month containing the 15th

options.description: School / rule options as { group: id }; defaults match mingge.org. See list_options for groups and ids.

name: ziwei_limits
